comparison: Prior vector range insertion versus chunked range insertion; allocator max_size boundary handling also differs. Both retain the earlier main-array capacity fix.
timing: Native heap runs are used for time comparisons. Requested-byte tracking runs are used for memory comparisons. Nine alternating A/B samples after warmup; each row is an average of the specified iteration count.
memory: Includes requested bytes for input, live elements, temporary buffers, directory and string storage; excludes tracking headers, malloc metadata and process working set. Memory measurements are performed once per case, not once per timing row.
input_iterator: Prepared vector exposed through an input iterator without subtraction; parser, stream and I/O costs are excluded.
scope: 128 and 100000 inserted elements; four element types; front/middle/back; fragmented layout. Control operations also measured. No generalization to other machines, allocators, block sizes or counts.
